{"has_issues": true, "issues": ["The memo labels the facility as PDP (pre-delivery payment) financing, yet claims the financing is secured by \u2018tangible, mobile collateral assets (59 new Airbus aircraft)\u2019\u2014in a PDP structure the aircraft are typically not yet delivered and cannot serve as tangible collateral, implying conflicting statements about the collateral."]}
